title: Residential roofing
shortDesc: A house roof that leaks or is worn out lets water into the rooms you live in. We look at the house, then write the estimate.
fullDesc: A stain on the ceiling or a roof that is past its years is not a problem that stays on the roof. {{name}} looks at the house in {{city}}, then gives you a written estimate. Call {{phone}}.
highlights: Written estimate after we see the roof
heading: When the house roof starts letting water in
body: A patch that fails again means the leak is still finding a way inside. {{name}} roofs homes and commercial buildings. Call {{phone}} and we look at the house before anyone names a price.

faq.a: Faber Roof's site says it roofs homes and businesses. Call {{phone}} about a specific house.

title: Commercial roofing
shortDesc: A commercial roof problem can stop a close or soak the space underneath. We look at the building, then write the estimate.
fullDesc: Water in a commercial space does not wait for a convenient week. {{name}} looks at the building, then gives you a written estimate. Call {{phone}}.
highlights: Written estimate after we see the roof
heading: When the building roof is in the way of the business
body: A leak over a workspace or a roof that holds up a sale needs a look, not a guess from the street. {{name}} does commercial and residential roofing. Call {{phone}} with the address.

faq.a: The site says Faber Roof does commercial and residential roofing. Call {{phone}} with the address.

title: Shingle roofing
shortDesc: Curling or missing shingles let the next storm into the deck. We look at the roof, then write the estimate. CertainTeed and Landmark Pro marks are on our materials.
fullDesc: Missing shingles and a soft spot in the deck get worse every rain. {{name}} shows shingle roofs in its project photos and displays CertainTeed and Landmark Pro marks. Call {{phone}} to confirm the product for your roof.
heading: When the shingles are no longer keeping water out
body: A bundle of new shingles does not help until someone looks at what is under the old ones. {{name}} shows CertainTeed and Landmark Pro marks and photos of shingle roofs. Those are not the only products we may install. Call {{phone}}.

faq.a: The current site shows CertainTeed and Landmark Pro marks. Call {{phone}} to confirm what goes on a specific roof.

title: Metal roofing
shortDesc: If shingles keep failing on a roof you want to stop replacing, ask about metal. A standing-seam roof is in our project photos. Call to see if it fits your building.
fullDesc: Another shingle replacement on a roof that wants metal is money spent twice. {{name}} publishes a photo of a standing-seam metal roof. Call {{phone}} to ask whether metal is an option for your building.
highlights: Confirm the system on your estimate
heading: When you want to stop repeating the same shingle job
body: A standing-seam metal roof with skylights is in the project photos. Confirm that system on your estimate before you plan on metal. Call {{phone}}.

faq.a: A standing-seam metal roof is pictured on faberroof.com. Call {{phone}} to ask about your building.
